items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: No, no, Zooey Robinson was used to play tram on at Larry's.

ctx.x: I thought maybe you were talking about Zooey Robinson.

No, no, Zooey Robinson was used to play tram on at Larry's. Oh, yeah. He went over to the rubber show. And when Zooey left, then Johnny Lindsay came and took Zooey's place. I see. Zooey went to Chicago. Johnny came and played in Zooey's place. Johnny Lindsay.
How many days you had steady you worked with Chris? Were you a member of Chris's band? Who me?
